ORB Exploration, Bayou Sorrel, Outside Baton Rouge, LA

2013-01-15
On 15JAN13, USCG MSU Baton Rouge contact NOAA SSC in regards to a spill in Bayou Sorrel which occurred on 3JAN13. USCG was notified on 15JAN of the spill and gather information. The spill is estimated 100 bbl and OSRO on-scene has submitted a formal request to conduct in-situ burn. USCG is seeking advise from NOAA SSC on this matter.
